title: Single Point of Failure: The (Fictional) Day Google Forgot To Check Passwords
summary: Tom Scott performs a fictional story at GeekyConf about the day Google accidentally stops checking passwords, letting anyone into any account. It works as a parable about how a single point of failure in login can unravel everything built on it.
why: HN commenters cite it as the canonical thought experiment whenever authentication failures, account compromises or Google outages come up.

quote.text: It's basically the scenario Tom Scott laid out about what would happen if Google stopped checking passwords
